cells.value: Certificate for Overload Capability (Type test - 125% of rated current)
Certificate for Short circuit (Type test - 150% of rated current)
Check tally plate and circuit diagram plate.
Check all incoming and outgoing supply cables are provisioned with bolted type terminals and crimped lugs/ sockets of electrolytic copper.
Check for the component access. Access to a component shall not be impeded by other components or wiring.
Enclosure - </br> IP 43 for ATS > 100 amps </br> IP 55 for ATS < 100 amps
Insulation Resistance Checks. </br> 4.8.1 Insulation value between each Phase and Earth (>2 MΩ)
Voltage Tolerance (±10%). Check 'Normal' and 'Alternate' power supplies at Input & Output end terminals.
Check the proper operation of all indication lamp by test lamp button (If available).
Testing by Test Push. Press 'Test push button' (provided on panel) & hold until switch has changed to 'Alternate' supply. On release switch will revert to 'Normal' supply.
Check the local and remote operation of ATS (if any).
Para 2 of Chapter III of EED-50-78

5.6.1 Auto Mode. Reduce/increase incoming voltage supply for main/alternate supply using variac. ATS will trigger when voltage goes out of the limit of ± 10 % of rated voltage. Observed change over time (>20 ms) - milli seconds.

5.6.2 Manual Mode. Reduce/increase incoming voltage supply for main supply using variac and alternate supply to be available. ATS will trigger when main supply voltage goes out of the limit of ± 10 % of rated voltage. Observed change over time (>20 ms) - milli seconds.
5.6.3 Manual Bypass (Emergency Mode). If the ATS itself becomes defective, then the load gets transferred to Normal and Alternate supply through a manual bypass switch based on the selection of user.
ATS Trials with System Load. Check the ATS with system load and ensure proper operation of equipment without power supply interruption while changeover.
